gloss.s.findwork.1: I want to apply for the job.
gloss.s.findwork.2: Is the contract temporary or permanent?
gloss.s.findwork.3: May I have a copy of the contract?
gloss.c.findwork.q: What kind of work are you looking for?
gloss.c.findwork.a: I am looking for work in a warehouse.
gloss.s.contract.1: How many hours do I work per week?
gloss.s.contract.2: How long is the trial period?
gloss.s.contract.3: Which collective agreement is for me?
gloss.c.contract.q: Can you come to work tomorrow?
gloss.c.contract.a: Yes, what time must I be there?
gloss.s.payslip.1: What is my pay per hour?
gloss.c.payslip.a: Yes, but some hours are missing.
gloss.s.extra.1: Do I get extra pay for night work?
gloss.s.extra.3: My pay goes into my bank account.
gloss.c.extra.q: Can you stay two hours longer today?
gloss.c.extra.a: Yes, will you write down the overtime?
gloss.s.health.1: I have a right to a break.
gloss.s.health.3: I report it to the Labour Inspectorate.
gloss.c.health.q: You must take a break now.
gloss.c.health.a: Okay, I will sit down for a bit.
gloss.s.rights.1: I want to make a complaint.
gloss.s.rights.2: I am a member of the union.
gloss.c.rights.a: No, I am not signing yet.
gloss.w.aanvragen: to ask for, to apply for
gloss.s.leave.1: I want to ask for leave.
gloss.s.leave.2: Am I free on the public holiday?
gloss.s.leave.3: I have an emergency at home.
gloss.c.leave.q: When do you want to go on holiday?
gloss.s.illness.2: I have an appointment with the company doctor.
gloss.s.illness.3: Tomorrow I will come back to work.
gloss.c.illness.q: What exactly is wrong with you?
gloss.c.illness.a: I will talk about that with the company doctor.
gloss.c.findwork.b: Always ask for a written contract and a copy for yourself. Read it before you sign, or ask someone you trust to help you. A temp agency (uitzendbureau) may not ask you for money to find you a job. General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.findwork.p: May I read the contract first?
gloss.c.findwork.s: A new employer says: "Sign here now. You can read it later." What do you do?
gloss.c.findwork.o1: Ask for time to read it, or for a copy to read at home.
gloss.c.findwork.o2: Sign quickly, so you do not lose the job.
gloss.c.findwork.w: Your contract says what you earn and what your rights are. A good employer gives you time to read it. You may ask about everything you do not understand.
gloss.c.contract.b: A trial period (proeftijd) must be in writing. It is not allowed in a contract of 6 months or shorter. In a contract shorter than 2 years it is at most 1 month. In a contract of 2 years or longer, or a permanent one, it is at most 2 months. On-call worker (oproepkracht)? Your employer must call you at least 4 days before. If it is later, you do not have to come. If they call you for less than 3 hours of work, you get paid for 3 hours. General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.contract.p: Is the trial period in my contract?
gloss.c.contract.s: Your contract is for 3 months. It says: "Proeftijd: 1 maand". What do you do?
gloss.c.contract.o1: Ask about it calmly: a trial period is not allowed in a contract this short.
gloss.c.contract.o2: Nothing. Every contract has a trial period.
gloss.c.contract.o3: Sign and never ask, because the boss knows best.
gloss.c.contract.w: A trial period in a contract of 6 months or shorter does not count. Asking calmly is normal. If the answer is not clear, get advice from the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.payslip.b: Bruto is your pay before tax. Netto is what you get in your bank account: bruto minus tax and premiums (loonheffing). Check the hours and the pay on every payslip (loonstrook), and write down the hours you work. Do you have two jobs? Ask for the tax credit (loonheffingskorting) at only one employer. General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.payslip.p: I worked more hours. Can you check it?
gloss.c.payslip.s: Your payslip shows fewer hours than you worked. What do you do?
gloss.c.payslip.o1: Ask your supervisor calmly to check it and show your own notes.
gloss.c.payslip.o2: Say nothing, because you do not want problems.
gloss.c.payslip.o3: Stay home the next day without telling anyone.
gloss.c.payslip.w: Mistakes on a payslip happen. Asking about it is normal and it is your right. Your own notes of dates and hours help a lot.
gloss.c.extra.b: You get holiday pay (vakantiegeld): at least 8% of your gross wage. Most employers pay it once a year, in May or June. Your pay may never be lower than the legal minimum wage (minimumloon); for workers under 21 it is lower. The amount changes every year: check it on rijksoverheid.nl. A cao often gives extra pay for overtime or night work. General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.extra.p: When do I get my holiday pay?
gloss.c.extra.s: A colleague says: "In May you get extra money from the boss." What is it?
gloss.c.extra.o1: Holiday pay: at least 8% of your gross wage.
gloss.c.extra.o2: A present, only for the best workers.
gloss.c.extra.o3: A loan that you must pay back later.
gloss.c.extra.w: Holiday pay is your right, not a gift. You build it up with every hour you work. If you leave your job earlier, you get it with your last pay.
gloss.c.health.b: The law protects your health. After 5.5 hours of work you get at least 30 minutes of break (it may be 2 times 15 minutes). After 10 hours: at least 45 minutes. You may work at most 12 hours in one shift and 60 hours in one week. Unsafe work or too little pay? You can report it to the Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie, also without giving your name. General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.health.p: I have not had a break yet.
gloss.c.health.s: You have worked 6 hours without a break. Your supervisor asks you to keep going. What do you do?
gloss.c.health.o1: Say politely that you need your break now.
gloss.c.health.o2: Keep working and skip your break every day.
gloss.c.health.o3: Leave work and go home without a word.
gloss.c.health.w: A break after 5.5 hours is the law, not a favour. Rest also helps you work safely.
gloss.c.rights.b: Discrimination at work is forbidden, for example because of your origin, religion or gender. Your employer cannot simply fire you: normally they need permission from UWV or a judge, or your agreement. (In a trial period or at the end of a temporary contract, other rules apply.) Do not sign a paper about your dismissal that you do not understand. Get help first from the union (for example FNV), a discrimination help desk or the Juridisch Loket (free legal advice). General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.rights.p: I want to ask for advice first.
gloss.c.rights.s: Your boss gives you a paper: "Sign today, then you leave by agreement." You do not understand it well. What do you do?
gloss.c.rights.o1: Do not sign yet. Ask for time and get advice first.
gloss.c.rights.o2: Sign it, because the boss says it is fine.
gloss.c.rights.o3: Put the paper away and never talk about it.
gloss.c.rights.w: If you sign, you can lose rights, for example to unemployment benefit (WW). Asking for time to get advice is normal and allowed.
gloss.c.leave.b: By law you get paid days off: at least 4 times the days you work per week. Full-time, 5 days a week? Then at least 20 days a year. A cao can give more. Ask for leave in time, and in writing. A sudden emergency, like an accident or illness in your family? Then you can get short leave with pay (calamiteitenverlof). Tell your employer right away. General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.leave.p: I would like to ask for leave for July.
gloss.c.leave.s: You want to visit your family abroad for three weeks in summer. What do you do?
gloss.c.leave.o1: Ask your employer for leave early, in writing.
gloss.c.leave.o2: Just go, and tell your boss when you are back.
gloss.c.leave.o3: Ask a colleague to tell the boss the day before.
gloss.c.leave.w: Your employer plans the work and must agree to the dates. Asking early gives the best chance of a yes.
gloss.c.illness: Your rights when you are sick
gloss.c.illness.b: When you are sick, your employer must pay at least 70% of your wage. A cao often gives more. There can be up to 2 waiting days (wachtdagen) without pay. Your boss may not ask what illness you have: you talk about your health and your work with the company doctor (bedrijfsarts). Call your employer when you are better (beter melden). Working through an agency? The rules can be different: ask your agency. General information. For your situation: ask your employer, the union or the Juridisch Loket.
gloss.c.illness.p: I am better again. I will come to work tomorrow.
gloss.c.illness.s: You are sick for a week. Your employer asks you to visit the company doctor. What do you do?
gloss.c.illness.o1: Go, and talk with the doctor about your health and your work.
gloss.c.illness.o2: Do not go, because you already have your own doctor.
gloss.c.illness.o3: Go back to work while you are still sick, so you do not have to go.
gloss.c.illness.w: The company doctor helps you get back to work in a healthy way. The doctor does not tell your boss your medical details, only what work you can do.
